key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:0000
name: parse_cli_and_run_setpatch
description: Allocates a state block, then splits the command line into a null-terminated argument table, handling quoted strings and star escapes for newline and escape characters. It then runs the main setup routine and releases the resources it allocated before returning.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:0:01A0
name: restore_patch_state
description: Stores the given value into a slot of a state block, then calls up to three cleanup routines whose conditions depend on which slots are non-zero. It returns the value it stored.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:3:0000
name: run_guarded_call_sequence
description: Calls one routine, then, only when a global flag is non-zero, passes the input value through a second routine and feeds that result into a third. It finishes by calling a final routine unconditionally.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:3:0030
name: apply_setpatch_patches
description: Sets a patch-enabled flag from the argument count, prints the usage text when a question mark argument is given, and patches several library and exec vectors and a task structure. Its text strings cover the patched subsystems, the layers and trackdisk libraries, and the already-patched message.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:15:0004
name: call_indirect_via_table
description: Calls a routine through a pointer read from a global structure at a fixed offset, then returns the value the called routine left in the data register.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:8:0000
name: allocate_and_patch_memory
description: If the state fields and the memory-size check allow it, it obtains a block of memory from an absolute or general pool under a task lock, copies a code stub into the block and stores the block pointer in the state structure. It then stores the complement of a 16-bit checksum over 22 words and returns 0; otherwise it returns the error code 20.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:8:00B4
name: store_checksum_and_jump
description: Computes a 16-bit checksum over 22 words of a state block, stores its complement in a field of that block, then transfers control to a routine whose address comes from a pointer. The pointer is shifted by 30 bytes when a marker value is found at that location.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:0000
name: disable_interrupts_for_patch
description: Opens the disk resource and, when its version is below 36, writes a disable value to the interrupt-enable register and adjusts a nesting counter around two library calls. It re-enables interrupts only when the counter was zero before the call, and returns -1 on success or 0 otherwise.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:007C
name: check_flag_and_copy_word
description: Calls a routine through a global pointer and, when it returns non-zero, copies a 32-bit field at a fixed offset of a global structure into a global variable.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:0094
name: dispatch_if_value_matches
description: Returns without action when a stored value differs from a field of a global structure and is not minus one. Otherwise it tail-calls a routine through a global pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:13:00A8
name: dispatch_if_minus_one
description: Returns without action when the input register is not minus one. Otherwise it tail-calls a routine through a global pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:5:0000
name: install_guarded_memory_hook
description: Writes a disable value to the interrupt-enable register, then, if a marker is missing at low memory, writes the marker and two state words there. It then calls one of two routines from a table, chosen by a memory flag, and skips the marker writes on later calls.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:5:0042
name: jump_to_secondary_handler
description: Jumps through a pointer read from a fixed offset of a global structure, passing control to the routine it names without any return to this code.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:0000
name: initialize_patch_function_table
description: Stores a computed address, built from a pointer and a signed byte, into a global variable. It then fills sixteen consecutive entries of a table with addresses of a routine, each two bytes after the previous one.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:0038
name: stub_jump_table_entries
description: Holds sixteen consecutive entries of an unresolved jump table, each calling the same unnamed routine. The pseudo-code shows only the table layout and performs no computation of its own.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:003C
name: stub_jump_table_entries
description: Holds sixteen consecutive entries of an unresolved jump table, each calling the same unnamed routine. The pseudo-code shows only the table layout and performs no computation of its own.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:003E
name: stub_jump_table_entries
description: Holds fifteen consecutive entries of an unresolved jump table, each calling the same unnamed routine, and returns the result of the final call. The pseudo-code shows only the table layout and performs no computation of its own.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:9:005E
name: return_input_value
description: Returns the value it received in the data register unchanged, performing no other operations.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:0000
name: set_function_for_old_versions
description: Returns immediately when the library version field exceeds 35. Otherwise it calls a library vector that sets a function pointer.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:001E
name: copy_structure_with_allocations
description: Allocates a copy of a structure and fills it with pairs read from the source, allocating a further block for each non-zero pointer pair. On failure it frees the blocks already allocated and returns the error with its top bit set; otherwise it returns the new structure.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:0080
name: free_block_list_and_return
description: Frees a counted series of memory blocks through a library vector, decrementing a counter until it becomes negative. It then frees one more block and returns a stored value with its top bit set.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:7:0094
name: free_block_and_return_marked
description: Frees one memory block through a library vector, then returns a stored value with its top bit set.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:6:0010
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Performs no work and returns immediately to its caller.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:12:0000
name: test_value_then_run_callbacks
description: Passes a field at offset 68 of a structure through a test routine. When the test returns non-zero, it calls a routine with no arguments and then a second routine with the same field value, and it returns whether the test passed.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:0000
name: scan_for_marker_word
description: Advances through consecutive 16-bit words from the given pointer until it finds one whose high byte is 97, then returns a pointer to that word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:001E
name: advance_by_encoded_displacement
description: Reads a signed displacement from the word at the given position: when its low byte is zero the displacement is the following 16-bit word, otherwise it is the sign-extended low byte. It returns the position reached by advancing by that displacement plus one word.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:0050
name: compute_relative_word_target
description: Reads a 16-bit value two bytes past the input pointer, halves it, sign-extends it from its top bit, then returns the input pointer advanced by twice that value plus two bytes.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:10:0076
name: store_three_relative_pointers
description: Walks a sequence of positions starting two bytes past the input pointer, computing each position with a helper routine, and stores the three resulting pointers in consecutive global variables.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:17:0000
name: call_with_stack_slot_pointer
description: Forwards its two parameters to another routine together with the address of a slot in its own stack frame, then returns.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:setpatch:16:0000
name: format_text_and_forward
description: Calls the exec RawDoFmt routine through a global vector to format text into a 140-byte stack buffer. It then measures the text up to its terminating zero and, when the text is non-empty, passes the buffer and its length to another routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:endcli:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When the given destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset of a structure into it. It then calls a routine held in a register.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro:0:0000
name: load_hunks_and_relocate
description: Allocates memory for each hunk of the executable and walks the hunk records, copying code and data hunks into place, skipping BSS hunks and applying 32-bit relocation entries by adding the base address. It releases the allocation on the failure path and then calls a cleanup routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro:0:0112
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Performs no work and returns immediately to its caller.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro:0:011C
name: spin_delay_loop
description: Spins by decrementing a count register until it passes zero, so it waits for a count-dependent number of iterations and does no other work.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro:0:015C
name: unpack_backward_compressed_stream
description: Decompresses a packed stream into a buffer, filling it from the end toward the start. A zero control value copies a run of raw bytes, while other control values copy a run of earlier output at a variable distance, stopping when the output reaches the start boundary.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro:0:01EA
name: decrement_byte_with_space_wrap
description: Decrements a byte register once per iteration for a count-based number of iterations, replacing a zero result with a space character. It accesses no memory and calls no other routine.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:intro:0:0204
name: invalidate_cache_lines
description: Calls a cache-invalidation library function with a zero argument. The bytes after that call decode as invalid data, so this is only a short stub.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0000
name: trap_copy_word_handler
description: Raises a trap, copies one 16-bit word from the source pointer to the destination pointer, sets a global flag to a fixed value, and returns the two data registers unchanged.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0006
name: conditional_flag_set_or_mask
description: Sets a global flag to a fixed value and returns the data register unchanged. When the overflow and negative flag states differ and the carry flag is set, it instead returns the data register with a bit mask applied and leaves the flag alone.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0016
name: set_port_status_bit
description: Sets bit 1 (value 2) of a global variable that stands for the CIA port register, which the register note ties to the fire-button and disk status lines.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0020
name: read_input_flags
description: Builds a small status byte from two bits of a global variable: one value when bit 6 is clear, and a second bit added when bit 2 is clear. It returns that byte.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0074
name: store_fixed_status_code
description: Stores a fixed code value into a global variable and returns.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0088
name: store_status_value_eight
description: Stores the constant eight into a global variable and returns.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:009C
name: advance_random_state_divmod
description: Advances a 32-bit shift-register state held in memory by doubling it and XORing in a fixed constant when the shift carries out or yields zero. For a positive divisor it returns the low word of the state divided and reduced by that divisor, packed into one register; for a non-positive divisor it stores the negated value into the state instead.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:00C8
name: decode_keyboard_serial_code
description: When a flag bit is set, it returns a byte made by inverting a global value and rotating it right by one bit, then waits a fixed delay loop and clears a second flag bit. Otherwise it returns zero, matching the keyboard serial register the register note names.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:00FA
name: translate_code_via_table
description: Reads a code from the byte reader and, unless its top bit is set or it is zero, searches a 49-entry table of 16-bit codes for it. It returns the matching entry from the parallel table, or zero when there is no match.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0120
name: lookup_table_entry_in_place
description: Searches a 49-entry table of 16-bit codes for the key in a state slot and stores the parallel table entry, or zero when no match is found, into a result slot. It copies that result back over the key slot and returns it.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0128
name: continue_table_lookup_from_index
description: Continues a search of a 49-entry table of 16-bit codes from the index in a register, storing the parallel entry for a matching key and stopping once a non-zero result is stored or the index reaches 49. It copies the result over the key slot and returns it.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0166
name: fill_bitplane_pointer_template
description: Copies a 180-word template into a buffer, then writes the high and low halves of eight address pointers into fixed slots. The first pointer is the given address and the others step by 8000 bytes, each high half masked to six bits.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:01C0
name: write_plane_pointers_from_frame
description: Copies template words up to a count held in a frame slot, then writes high and low address halves taken from six frame slots into fixed positions of the buffer. It fills seven further address slots with a shared value.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0314
name: write_structure_default_constants
description: Writes a fixed set of sixteen-bit constants at fixed offsets of a structure reached through a global pointer. Two of the fields are set to the twelve-bit maximum.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0396
name: store_address_and_control_words
description: Writes a control word, a 32-bit parameter as an address, a zero word and a second control word into a structure reached through a global pointer. The control word at one offset is written twice, first with a value that clears bits and then with one that sets them.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:03C4
name: read_global_pointer
description: Returns the 32-bit value stored at a fixed offset from the global base.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:03D0
name: update_bitplane_pointers_if_set
description: Stores the first parameter into a global slot unless it is minus one. Unless the second parameter is minus one, it calls a helper and writes that address's high and low halves into the buffer's pointer slots, with four further pointers stepping by 8000 bytes.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:03FA
name: wait_raster_then_write_pointers
description: Waits for the display beam to reach a raster line, then writes the high and low halves of five address pointers into the buffer's slots. The pointers start at the given address and step by 8000 bytes.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:04E4
name: copy_sixteen_words_spaced
description: Copies sixteen 16-bit words from the source buffer into a structure reached through a global pointer, placing them every four bytes starting at a fixed offset.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0522
name: configure_blitter_parameters
description: Stores eleven parameters into fixed offsets of a structure reached through a global pointer, combining two of them into one size field with the second multiplied by 64. It then waits for the blitter to finish.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:05E4
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Performs no work and returns immediately to its caller.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:05EC
name: invoke_helper_routines
description: Calls a helper with an address computed from a base register, then calls a helper with two minus-one arguments, and finally calls a third helper with no arguments.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:06A2
name: obtain_handle_and_read_field
description: Calls a library function with a minus-two argument to obtain a handle. When the handle is non-zero it passes it to two routines and returns a 32-bit field from a global structure; otherwise it returns zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:06EE
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Performs no work and returns immediately to its caller.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:06F2
name: obtain_dh0_handle_read_short
description: Calls a library function with a pointer to the DH0 device name and a minus-two argument to obtain a handle. When the handle is non-zero it passes it to two routines and returns the low 16 bits of a 32-bit field from a global structure; otherwise it returns zero.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0748
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Performs no work and returns immediately to its caller.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:0750
name: call_seven_unnamed_routines
description: The decompiled code is unavailable, so this entry records only that the routine makes seven calls to unnamed routines and is called by seven others. It has 23 instructions and no library, register or text references.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:07A0
name: return_constant_one
description: Returns the constant one and does nothing else.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:07A4
name: return_constant_minus_one
description: Returns the constant minus one and does nothing else.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:07A8
name: add_byte_and_check_result
description: Adds a byte from a structure to the byte at offset two of a pointed-to block, then passes that block to a helper. It returns minus one when the helper returns zero and zero otherwise.

key: future wars - time travellers (1989)(u. s. gold)[cr bz&a](disk 1 of 2)/Future Wars - Time Travellers (1989)(U. S. Gold)[cr BZ&A](Disk 1 of 2).adf:delphine:0:07D8
name: return_constant_minus_one
description: Returns the constant minus one and does nothing else.
